dct_description_sm: McKinley quadrangle topographic map (N4730-W9222.5/7.5) featuring handwritten notations by Ray Segar in pencil and red ink regarding logging railroad lines and camps in the area north of McKinley. The hand written notations include information on the following, logging camps noted with 'C'; Gull River Logging company.
